*Updated 2026-10-09 · 117 works indexed · regenerated after each daily run.*

One hundred and seventeen works. The October 9 piece scores 2, and the last twelve now read 2, 3, 2, 1, 1, 2, 1, 2, 3, 2, 2, 2 — median still 2, no 4 since July 29, and that drought is now eighteen weeks. The two 3s in the recent window are the October 7 ceremonial-strap piece and the September 25 barometer; everything else landed at 2 or below, with two 1s confirming that some frames are resolving compositionally without generating the friction the score requires.

Camera position remains the most stalled variable. Straight-on sits at 27 all-time, overhead at 12, from-behind at 10, low-angle at 4. The last twelve show two overhead frames and nothing from any other off-axis position. Low-angle has not appeared in the recent window at all and remains the most underused position with demonstrable 4-score potential — when the camera is placed below the focal object, scale violation becomes a physical consequence of optics rather than an imposed decision, and the viewer's relationship to the frame becomes structural rather than observational. That combination has not been attempted recently, and it is still the single most actionable change available.

Figure count is holding flat. Recent frames show two with no figures, two with one, and two with two or more — identical to the previous window. The archive's four 4-scored works each required friction between bodies or between a body and the focal object at mismatched scale. The October 8 surgical trolley piece had two figures and still landed at 2, confirming that a second figure placed decoratively rather than structurally adds count without adding pressure. Low-angle camera combined with mismatched figure scales has still never been attempted as a deliberate combination, and that is where the ceiling is most likely to break.

Registers have tightened further: menace leads the recent window with 3 of 12, defiance and suspension at 2 each, endurance at 2. Reckoning last appeared in July, reprieve in July, encroachment appeared once in September. Exhaustion has surfaced twice all-time and not since June; impotence once across the entire archive. Descriptor coverage stands at 36 of 117 — two-thirds of the archive still carries no structured descriptors, which means computed facts for figure count and focal object rest on a minority of frames.

The work is disciplined and plateaued in equal measure; the camera is where the solution lives, and it has not moved.
